ERA Tobin Estate Agents are proud to offer to the market this stunning four bedroom bungalow with large detached garage which also qualifies for the vacant home grant. Large elevated site circa one acre with magnificent landscaped gardens and asphalt / concrete driveway surrounding just over 2km from Ballybay. Rare opportunity to purchase a property of this quality, offering the complete package with a host of additional extras and features throughout in this location.


Features include: Alarm, OFCH, quality sanity ware, U.P.V.C. double glazed windows and doors, window blinds, fully fitted kitchen and utility, built in vacuum system, quality sanitary ware, asphalt driveway, stone bellmouth entrance, outside lighting, elevated site, cobble lock patio area, cattle grid,  landscaped gardens, floor area 155m²,  BER C .

Accommodation Comprises:  Entrance Hallway L - shaped: 6.1m x 2.6m x 10.9m x 1.5m, Sitting room: 5.6m x 3.9m, Kitchen / dining: 7.5m x 4.2m, Guest w.c.: 2.4m x 1.1m; Utility: 3.1m x 2.5m, Bathroom: 3.2m x 2.4m, Master Bedroom: 4.3m x 3.7m, Ensuite: 3.4m x 1.3, Bedroom 2: 4.2m x 3.3m, Bedroom 3: 3.6m x 3.3m, Bedroom 4m x 3.3m, Garage: 7.3m x 7.3m.

Guide Price: €375,000
